title: Engenheiro de dados Senior
description:
MUITO MAIS QUE UMA STARTUP

Somos um hub de serviços e produtos financeiros escaláveis.

Somos a fintech do Grupo Energisa, que há 120 anos leva energia de qualidade a milhões de brasileiros, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do país. Criamos produtos que aceleram a inclusão digital e financeira de clientes de todo o Brasil.

Desde 2021, levamos produtos inovadores para o ecossistema do Grupo Energisa (empresa, clientes e fornecedores).

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

O dia a dia:

  • Estudar e entender estratégias para desenvolvimento de soluções que envolvam dados, indicadores e ferramentas para alavancagem de satisfação de clientes e eficiência do processo, construindo soluções técnicas para obter, processar e armazenar dados de várias fontes.
  • Atuar como Especialista em determinados domínios de conhecimento e em determinadas ferramentas/técnicas.
  • Detectar problemas de qualidade de dados através da detecção de problemas de dados, pipeline e modelo.
  • Definir e construir controles, indicadores e monitoramentos para gestão de produtos digitais.
  • Preparar dados para modelagem prescritiva e preditiva.
  • Identificar e corrigir erros mais sutis em dados e análises.
  • Garantir que os resultados sejam reprodutíveis, corretos e acionáveis.
  • Analisar e organizar dados brutos, realizando análises complexas de dados, e relatar os resultados obtidos.
  • Apoiar na utilização das melhores ferramentas de BI e Advanced Analytics.
  • Apoiar a evolução do nível de maturidade em Analytics.
  • Disseminar o uso de melhores práticas de dados e Analytics para construção de um ambiente orientado a dados.
  • Escrever queries básicas.
  • Realizar deploy.
  • Realizar consultas e extração de informações de banco de dados (GCP/BigQuery).
  • Apoiar no bom funcionamento do ambiente e suas rotinas.
  • Criar segmentações, análises de dados, geração de insights, execução de cálculos de métricas e KPIs, visando atender a demandas das áreas de negócio.
  • Apoiar o time de Dados no planejamento e mensuração das principais métricas voltadas para objetivo do negócio.
  • Integrar com os Desenvolvedores, a fim de propor soluções mais completas e efetivas dos painéis e relatórios a serem desenvolvidos.
  • Escrever whitepapers, pesquisas e notas claras e coerentes.
  • Documentar processos, modelos, rotinas e boas práticas de forma clara, padronizada e acessível, garantindo a rastreabilidade, reprodutibilidade e entendimento por outras áreas ou novos integrantes do time.
  • Solucionar problemas e manter a Gerência informada, trabalhando em estreita colaboração com Desenvolvedores para acelerar o processo de desenvolvimento e garantia de qualidade.
  • Apoiar o superior imediato em assuntos inerentes à sua área de atuação, apresentando e discutindo problemas e irregularidades, a fim de subsidiar a definição de procedimentos e ações a serem adotadas.
  • Observar o cumprimento dos procedimentos e normas aplicáveis às necessidades da área, identificando oportunidades de melhoria, através da análise e revisão dos mesmos.
  • Analisar os processos inerentes à sua área de atuação, propondo e sugerindo melhorias para a maximização dos resultados.
  • Manter-se atualizado quanto aos avanços tecnológicos referentes à sua área de atuação, visando o aprimoramento profissional, repasse de conhecimentos, sugestões de melhorias em equipamentos e processos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua.
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação do superior imediato.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Para essa posição, esperamos que você tenha:

Ensino Superior completo em Estatística, Matemática, Ciências da Computação ou Engenharias.

Experiência mínima de 5 anos em gerenciamento, otimização e monitoramento de recuperação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados brutos.

Conhecimento em Linguagem de Programação Python.

Conhecimento em Airflow.

Conhecimento em SQL.

Conhecimento em Computação na Nuvem para Engenharia de Dados (GCP).

Conhecimento em utilização de Git e versionamento de modelos.

Desejável inglês avançado.

Desejável cursos em Machine Learning.

Informações adicionais:

PARA MELHORAR O DIA A DIA:

  • Plano de saúde e Odontológico
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)
  • PLR atrelado a metas e resultados
  • Seguro de vida
  • Nav (consultas médicas e psicólogos online, sem custo)

title: Consultor
description:
Somos uma franquia Ortobom, presente em Ipanema desde 2019 e também com filial em outros pontos do Rio de Janeiro.

Ao longo da nossa trajetória, conquistamos destaque pelo atendimento humanizado, foco em resultados e compromisso em oferecer aos clientes o melhor em conforto, tecnologia e qualidade de vida.

Nosso time é formado por profissionais apaixonados por vendas, que acreditam na importância de entender as necessidades de cada cliente e proporcionar soluções personalizadas.

Estar na Ortobom é muito mais do que vender colchões: é fazer parte de uma marca líder no mercado, com mais de 50 anos de história, e ter a oportunidade de crescer junto com a empresa.

Se você busca um ambiente de crescimento, aprendizado constante e reconhecimento, aqui é o seu lugar!

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar atendimento consultivo e personalizado aos clientes (presenciais e online), identificando necessidades e oferecendo as melhores soluções em produtos Ortobom.
  • Apresentar diferenciais da marca, destacando qualidade, benefícios e inovação.
  • Negociar e conduzir o processo de vendas até o fechamento, garantindo a satisfação do cliente.
  • Trabalhar com metas de vendas e indicadores de desempenho, contribuindo para os resultados da equipe.
  • Acompanhar pós-venda, fidelizando clientes e fortalecendo relacionamentos.
  • Participar de treinamentos e capacitações para aprimorar habilidades e conhecimento dos produtos

Qualifications

  • Experiência prévia com vendas (varejo, shopping, consultivo ou porta a porta será um diferencial)
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Perfil proativo, dinâmico e com foco em resultados
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em escala e horários flexíveis
  • Ensino médio completo
  • Organização e disciplina para cumprir metas

Formulário de inscrição:

Importante

Agradecemos pelo interesse em fazer parte da Ortobomdaymond Rio de Janeiro.

Devido ao grande número de candidaturas, apenas os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista.

Nos esforçamos para dar retorno a todos, mas caso você não receba resposta da nossa equipe dentro de 15 dias, considere que, neste momento, sua candidatura não avançou para essa posição.

No entanto, valorizamos seu interesse e manteremos seu perfil em nosso banco de talentos para futuras oportunidades que estejam alinhadas às suas qualificações e experiência.

title: COORDENADOR DE GOVERNANÇA DE TI
description:

Garantir a implementação e manutenção de práticas de Governança de TI alinhadas às diretrizes corporativas e regulatórias do setor, promovendo a integridade, rastreabilidade, conformidade e performance dos processos de tecnologia, com foco em continuidade operacional, segurança cibernética, sustentabilidade e eficiência na gestão dos ativos digitais e operacionais.

title: Consultant
description: This role can be in Sao Paulo or Rio.  Heidrick Consulting Brazil  You would be part of our Consulting Practice in Brazil. At Heidrick Consulting, we work with Senior Leadership, Executive Teams, and Boards, covering major national and multi-national companies across all industry sectors in Brazil and Latin America.  You will be joining a growing, dynamic team, and in this role as an Engagement Leader, you will expand and deepen your consulting skills by leading various projects as well as managing junior team members. Your contributions will expose you to senior leaders across a variety of industries and geographies.  Primary Responsibilities  The main purpose of the Consultant is to develop consulting solutions as part of client engagements, to write proposals and support business development activities, to act as engagement manager on specific projects and to support Principals and Partners in their delivery.  You will begin to lead, manage, and own problem-solving efforts on a large portion of a client engagement or to lead on smaller engagements. Specifically, you will be responsible for identifying issues, forming hypotheses, designing and conducting analysis, and then synthesizing conclusions into recommendations. Throughout an engagement, you will be involved in discussions and presentations with senior client leadership.  Role Responsibilities:  Gathering, analyzing and interpreting data and information; generating insights from analyses.  Preparing and presenting information and insights in an impactful and compelling way to help drive client insights and engagement delivery.  Delivering a range of consulting solutions, preparing reports and other deliverables that meet client needs.  Facilitating and working with client teams with a client first mindset, managing and designing client sessions.  Ensuring work is “client ready” (e.g., error free, aligned with expectations, ready to be shared with client) and actively managing expectations with the team.  Planning and prioritizing work ensuring team deadlines and quality standards are met.  Contributing to proposals (e.g., supporting content development of project design and approaches and case studies) and mobilizing ‘won’ initiatives.  Building and sharing reusable, client ready materials, insights (including case studies) and project learnings.  Building and maintaining relationships with colleagues across Heidrick & Struggles in Brazil and globally.  Contributing to thought leadership and supporting the development of product, tools, and methodologies.  Involving yourself in internal initiatives, supporting ongoing improvements of business and employee experience; many initiatives are global and will provide an opportunity to build a global network.  The Ideal Candidate:  Passionate and Engaged:  Will bring a genuine enthusiasm for serving a broad variety of organizations on strategic people and talent topics, including leadership and team development, succession planning, Board effectiveness and organizational culture change.  Self-Driven and Inquisitive:  Exhibits a strong desire to continuously learn and explore new topics relevant to client organizations and industry sectors.  Entrepreneurial Spirit and Team Player:  Possesses an entrepreneurial mindset with a keen interest in contributing to a growing business unit. Brings innovative ideas and a proactive approach to delivering on agreed deadlines and client deliverables.  Minimum Role Qualifications   2-4 years of professional work experience, with a minimum of 2 years in a management, strategy or leadership consulting environment.  An undergraduate degree is required.  Experience working directly with clients in a professional service, team-based environment.  Ability to drive workload independently within a broader team project setting.  Ability to manage time effectively, being comfortable with handling multiple priorities and being able to adapt to changing business needs.  Demonstrated advanced proficiency in Power Point, Excel and Word; easily able to adopt new technologies and software.  Excellent communication skills; writing skills with a proven track record of success preparing concise and compelling reports and other client ready deliverables.  Ability to communicate, both verbally and in writing, in English and Portuguese. Other languages are a plus.  Willingness to travel locally and globally as required.

title: Estágio em engenharia de processos
description: A Aegea  Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.  Programa Respeito dá o Tom  O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.  Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.  A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.  Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.  Principais atividades:  Auxiliar na avaliação de documentos técnicos dentro do escopo de processos de tratamento de água e esgoto junto ao gestor;  Apoiar no desenvolvimento de planilhas de cálculo, documentos, relatórios ou apresentações;  Apoiar em pesquisas em artigos técnicos e literatura especializada.  Requisitos:  Estar cursando Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Química ou similares;  Conhecimento do Pacote Office;  Perfil com flexibilidade, alta curiosidade e desejo de aprender;  Disponibilidade para modelo híbrido (2 dias presenciais por semana);  Residir no Rio de Janeiro/RJ.  Benefícios  Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);  Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);  Seguro de vida;  Vale transporte;  Gympass;  Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;  Kit office.  A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +760 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 33 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.  Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Mep technical engineer
description: MEP Technical Engineer - UAE  Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.  This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.  Sau Paulo, Brazil  Rio de Janeiro, Brazil  Bogota, Columbia  Who we are! ALEC Engineering and Contracting L. L. C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises  In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.  ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.  Why Join Us? As an MEP Technical Engineer, you'll work alongside project leaders to ensure technical documents meet precise specifications, coordinate on-site execution, and uphold the quality of all MEP works. From pre-construction planning to close-out documentation, you'll help keep projects running smoothly and compliantly.  At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.  Your Role  Support Project Engineers in planning MEP systems for efficient project delivery  Prepare and review technical submittals, including drawings, materials, calculations, method statements, and reports  Maintain accuracy and completeness of technical documentation  Monitor and track submittal approvals to uphold timelines and quality expectations  Coordinate with other disciplines to ensure integrated site execution  Provide timely resolutions to site technical issues  Conduct site inspections to monitor work progress and compliance  Ensure installations meet local and international codes, standards, and project specifications  Assist with quantity take-offs, procurement, and logistics of MEP materials  Contribute to as-built documentation and final handover packages  Participate in meetings and maintain clear communication with all stakeholders  Pursue continuous learning through courses, seminars, and certifications  What We’re Looking For  Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (required)5 years of technical experience in MEP construction  Solid knowledge of MEP systems and design processes  Proficiency in MS Office; experience with  Revit  preferred  Familiarity with Autodesk tools and collaborative platforms  Strong understanding of design techniques and emerging technologies  Knowledge of relevant international and regional codes and standards  Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills  What We Offer  Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.  The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.  A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.  Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.  Ready to Lead? If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.  Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.  Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Offshore cargo supervisor
description: We are looking for an Offshore Cargo Supervisor for one of our clients in O& G, in an offshore position (14 X 14).  This is a TEMPORARY POSITION, for a 6 ~ 9 months (renewable) project.  Offshore Cargo Supervisor: What will your responsibilities and missions be? Responsible for supervising, monitoring, and participating in all marine-related activities, such as offloading operations, transshipment with support vessels, cargo handling and cleaning, ballasting operations, tank washing (COW), equipment maintenance, diving operations, and pull-in/pull-out operations. All these activities must be carried out with a focus on safety and in compliance with internal and external procedures and regulations, always in support of the Marine Superintendent and under his authority. He is also jointly responsible for ensuring the readiness and availability of the offshore facility's rescue equipment.  What Profile and Skills are Required for this Cargo Supervisor Position? Nationality: Brazilian Only  Local of work: Offshore – onboard FPSOs (boarding points: Jacarepaguá, Macaé, Farol de São Tomé, Cabo Frio, Maricá) English: Intermediate to Advanced  Graduation/Certificate:  Minimum: Marine or technical background — e.g., Marinheiro de Convés, CB, Mestre de Cabotagem or equivalent maritime certification.  Required Certifications (valid at embark): CBSP, CACI, CESS, MCIA, NR-33 (Confined Space), NR-35 (Work at Heights), H2 S Awareness, Benzeno Awareness, GASD, ECOW (modules 1 to 4) Search parameters: COW AND Ballast Operations AND Diving Support AND Lifesaving Equipment AND Offshore Cargo Handling  Experience:  Proven experience in offshore cargo operations, marine logistics, ballast management, and tank cleaning procedures  Experience coordinating diving support and marine safety inspections  Availability for temporary offshore rotation (14x14) Are you interested in this position? Send us your application! EP2 C Energy’s Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion  At EP2 C Energy, we are committed to fostering diversity and inclusion. We strongly encourage applications from individuals recognized as disabled workers. Our goal is to make a positive impact on the environment.  By joining our team, you will be expected to follow HSE procedures and best practices while contributing to the continuous improvement of our processes.  Who Are We? – EP2 C Energy  Founded in 2014,  EP2 C Energy  is a fast-growing technical assistance company specializing in:  Energy  (Renewable Energies, Oil & Gas, Nuclear) Life Sciences  (Pharmaceutical, Cosmetics, Food Industries) Large-Scale Industrial Projects  (Mining, Construction, Water Treatment, Petrochemicals, and Chemical Industries) With an international presence — including subsidiaries in Latin America, Africa, and Asia — we collaborate with major industry players and offer exciting career growth opportunities in France and worldwide.  At  EP2 C Energy  , we value our employees’ expertise and are committed to their professional and personal development.  Joining EP2 C Energy means becoming part of a dynamic team and an ambitious mission!

Esta não é uma venda tradicional; é o início de um relacionamento de longo prazo. Você será o rosto da Lobie no momento mais crucial: a ativação do ativo do nosso cliente.  Seu papel será garantir que cada investidor que adquire uma unidade em projetos parceiros entenda e adira aos nossos serviços de gestão e decoração, transformando um apartamento vazio em uma máquina de gerar receita.  Seus Desafios Serão:  Ativar a carteira de investidores que compram unidades nos empreendimentos parceiros, realizando o primeiro contato pós-compra.  Apresentar a tese de investimento da Lobie, demonstrando o potencial de rentabilidade através da nossa gestão especializada em locação de curta temporada.  Conduzir a venda do nosso produto  Lobie Decor  , uma solução completa que inclui projeto de arquitetura, compra de itens com custo reduzido pela escala e gestão total da implementação, deixando a unidade pronta para operar.  Construir e nutrir um relacionamento de confiança com os investidores, garantindo uma experiência de onboarding fluida e positiva.  Realizar a gestão do funil de vendas e atividades no CRM, assegurando o acompanhamento de todos os leads.  Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de Operações e Marketing para garantir a passagem de bastão perfeita após a contratação dos serviços.  O que Buscamos em Você:  Paixão por pessoas e pela construção de relacionamentos duradouros.  Excelente habilidade de comunicação verbal e escrita.  Perfil proativo, organizado e com forte senso de responsabilidade para gerenciar o "último metro" do processo comercial.  Vivência na área comercial ou de relacionamento com o cliente, preferencialmente B2 C.  Ensino Superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Relações Públicas ou áreas correlatas.  Interesse pelo mercado imobiliário, de investimentos e/ou design de interiores é um grande diferencial.  Por que se Juntar à Lobie? Impacto Real:  Você verá o resultado direto do seu trabalho na receita da companhia e na satisfação dos nossos clientes.  Crescimento Acelerado:  Faça parte de uma proptech em plena expansão, com o suporte de um dos grupos mais sólidos do setor imobiliário brasileiro.  Cultura de Inovação:  Trabalhe em um ambiente que combina tecnologia, dados e uma abordagem moderna para um mercado tradicional.  Desenvolvimento:  Oportunidade de aprender sobre investimentos, mercado imobiliário e vendas consultivas de alto valor.  Se você é uma pessoa comunicativa, organizada e movida pelo desafio de transformar um negócio em um relacionamento de sucesso, queremos te conhecer!#Lobie #Vagas #Analista Comercial #Comercial #Vendas #Last Mile #Proptech #Real Estate #Mercado Imobiliario #Rio De Janeiro #RJ

description: The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in building relationships with donors, sponsors, alumni, and community partners. The coordinator will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement. Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events. Contribuir para a construção de um plano de perdas sustentável, que una a inteligência financeira ao propósito de proteger o negócio de riscos e desperdícios.  Requisitos e qualificações  O que esperamos de você para essa vaga:  Domínio em gestão orçamentária e financeira.  Conhecimento em gestão contratual e compliance. Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro  QUEM SOMOS  Quem Somos:  Somos a Americanas, uma das maiores varejistas do país, com mais de 95 anos de história. Nossa marca, amada pelos brasileiros, tem o propósito de resolver a vida das famílias de maneira simples e descomplicada. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.   Valores e Propósito:  Nosso propósito é  resolver a vida das pessoas  , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. title: Technical engineer - design
description: Technical Engineer - Design | UAE  Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects? This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.  Sau Paulo, Brazil  Rio de Janeiro, Brazil  Bogota, Columbia  Who We are? ALEC Holdings L. L. C - S. O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.  In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.  ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.  Why Join Us? In the role of Technical Engineer, you will be responsible for managing a section of the build, ensuring that all designs are executed as per specifications, and any changes are effectively resolved and documented.  At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.  Your Role  Review Tender & IFC documents, 2 D drawings, BIM models & asset data in accordance with ISO19650.  Identify and resolve conflicting design elements through RFIs, CVIs, and workshops.  Oversee civil/infrastructure design deliverables throughout design and construction stages.  Support Design Manager in developing key project documentation including Project Execution Plans and QA/QC plans.  Coordinate multidisciplinary data and proactively mitigate potential constraints.  Prepare and manage RFIs/CVIs ensuring clarity and timely responses.  Assist in subcontractor coordination, reviewing shop drawings, and ensuring compliance with specifications.  Track drawing delivery schedules and support timely document submittals.  Liaise with planning teams to update working programmes and address technical queries from site. title: Principal pipeline drafter 25002281
description: Company Overview:  People power our future. That is why advancing a dynamic, inclusive environment, where everyone grows and thrives is critically important to us. Here, what you do matters.  Job Overview:  The Principal Pipeline Drafter directly impacts the effectiveness of their team and related team. They exchange ideas and information relating to Pipeline Drafting effectively. The Principal Pipeline Drafter may work autonomously within established Pipeline Drafting procedures and practices. They act as a lead, coordinating the work of others. The Principal Pipeline Drafter proposes improvements to processes and methods within the Pipeline Drafting discipline.  Key Tasks and Responsibilities:    Collaborate with project teams to develop and refine detailed piping system designs, ensuring compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project specifications  Prepare accurate and comprehensive 2 D and 3 D pipeline drawings, layouts, and schematics using computer-aided design and drafting (CADD) software  Review and interpret project drawings, specifications, and engineering deliverables to accurately capture project requirements and constraints  Coordinate with other disciplines such as process, mechanical, and structural engineering to integrate pipeline designs seamlessly into the overall project layout  Provide technical support and guidance to junior draftsmen to ensure high-quality and timely deliverables  Conduct interdisciplinary clash detection reviews to identify and mitigate clashes or conflicts among various piping systems, equipment, and structures  Assist in the preparation of material take-offs, bills of quantity (BOQ), and requisitions to support procurement activities  Continuously improve pipeline design processes and standards, staying updated with the latest industry practices, advancements, and technological tools  Collaboratively work with project managers and engineers to effectively communicate design progress, and challenges, and ensure timely completion of deliverables  Participate in design reviews, constructability assessments, and HAZOP studies to provide valuable insights and contributions to the project team  Implement Prefabrication, Erection methods, and DC reports information into shop drawing  Implement design change in the shop drawing based on approved SQ, TQ, SI and ARN  Identify non-original scope using Change Management System  Essential Qualifications and Education:  High School diploma or higher with a focus in Mechanical Engineering, Pipeline Engineering, or related field  Minimum of 8 years of Pipeline Drafter experience in the Oil & Gas Construction Industry, with a focus on pipelines, and demonstrates a strong understanding of pipeline design principles and practices.  Proficiency in using CAD software, such as Auto CAD, Navisworks, PDS, PDMS, Bently Microstation, or similar tools, for creating pipeline/piping designs and drawings  Familiarity with different pipeline materials, fittings, and supports, and their respective installation methods and constraints  Strong understanding of pipeline/piping design concepts, including isometric, orthographic, and schematic drawings  Deep knowledge of industry-specific codes and standards like ASME B31.3, ASME B31.4, API 570, API 1104 and ASME Sections VIII & IX  Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines  Detail-oriented mindset with a focus on accuracy and quality in drawing creation and review processes  Strong understanding of interdisciplinary coordination and interface management among various engineering disciplines  Effective communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders  Flexible and adaptable mindset to thrive in a dynamic and challenging work environment

A integração das mais de 1.600 lojas, presentes em todos os estados, e um e-commerce que complementa a experiência do físico nos permitem a realização de uma estratégia de vendas multicanal e eficiente, com foco na geração de caixa e na rentabilidade. Venha construir o futuro com a gente!   Nosso Jeito:  Nossa cultura é centrada no cliente, e buscamos constantemente soluções para aprimorar sua experiência. Valorizamos um jeito de trabalhar simples e descomplicado, que realmente gera impacto positivo na vida das pessoas. Aqui, incentivamos o trabalho em equipe e a troca de ideias, pois acreditamos que é assim que crescemos juntos, tanto como profissionais quanto como pessoas.   Valores e Propósito:  Nosso propósito é  resolver a vida das pessoas  , de maneira simples e descomplicada, guiada por valores autênticos e que representem a nossa gente. Buscamos entregar resultados com integridade, sempre servindo o cliente da melhor forma; priorizamos a conveniência em cada experiência, seja nas lojas, no site ou no coração de milhões de famílias; valorizamos a pluralidade e a resiliência, além de reconhecer e cuidar das nossas pessoas. Acima de tudo, nos comprometemos a ter um impacto positivo em tudo o que fazemos.  Diversidade e inclusão:  A Americanas S. A. acredita que diferentes perspectivas enriquecem o ambiente de trabalho. Por isso, temos o objetivo de promover um lugar cada vez mais diverso, inclusivo e acolhedor. Estamos construindo a cada dia uma cultura com base no respeito e valorização das diferenças, encorajando as pessoas a serem quem elas são, independente de gênero, etnia, raça, orientação sexual, religião ou deficiência. Nós acreditamos na integração das diversas culturas e tradições do Brasil, e queremos refletir a riqueza e a pluralidade do nosso país. Todas as nossas oportunidades são trabalhadas com base nesse princípio.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.  Organização de documentos e planilhas.  Apoio em projetos e indicadores das unidades da R4.  Participação em reuniões e elaboração de atas.  Apoio administrativo em demandas de hidráulica. Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta! Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença em mais de 892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.  Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 24.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Project engineer
description: Project Engineer | UAE  Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects? This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.  Sau Paulo, Brazil  Rio de Janeiro, Brazil  Bogota, Columbia  Who We are? ALEC Holdings L. L. C - S. O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.  In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.  ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.  Why Join Us? As a Project Engineer, you’ll oversee all engineering deliverables for your assigned scope, from design validation and approvals to procurement, compliance, and on-site execution. You’ll work alongside Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Supervisors, and Foremen, coordinating closely with planning, commercial, and MEP teams to ensure successful delivery on time, on budget, and fully compliant.  At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.  About Your Team  This role reports directly to the Operations Director and is part of the ALEC Data Centre Solutions core delivery team. The project delivery function oversees execution, programme coordination, stakeholder engagement, and quality control across all phases of construction. The team works closely with Planning, Commercial, Procurement, QA/QC, HSE, and Site Operations to ensure flawless execution.  Your Role  Review and interpret civil engineering drawings, specifications, and technical documents.  Coordinate with consultants, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders to ensure accurate execution.  Prepare and manage material submittals, RFIs, method statements, and risk assessments.  Monitor site progress, ensuring compliance with quality standards, safety procedures, and timelines.  Maintain accurate records, reports, and progress documentation.  Support project planning, cost control, and procurement activities.  Assist in resolving technical and site-related issues proactively.  Participate in inspections, testing, and handover processes.  What We’re Looking For  Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering (or equivalent). 5–10 years of relevant experience in large-scale civil construction projects.  Strong technical understanding of concrete, formwork, structural works, and finishing.  Familiarity with construction codes, safety regulations, and QA/QC procedures.  Proficiency in MS Office, Auto CAD, and project planning tools (Primavera P6 or MS Project).  Excellent communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.  What We Offer · The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects. · A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence. · Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.  Ready to plan the path to project success? If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.  Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.  Apply today and be part of something excellent! Kindly upload your CV in English.

You’ll manage technical submissions, resolve design conflicts, and act as a key link between subcontractors, design managers, and site teams, ensuring the highest standards of delivery and documentation across the board.  At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. Ensure timely, accurate document submissions and shop drawing updates through coordination with modelers and document controllers. Support value engineering initiatives and design change management.  Oversee and ensure accuracy of redline/as-built documentation and updates.  What We’re Looking For  Bachelor's degree in Architecture or equivalent 8–10 years of experience, including 3–5 years in a Senior Architect role with a main contractor  Strong proficiency in Revit (essential) Proficient in Auto CAD, Autodesk Revit, Adobe Acrobat, and MS Office  Solid understanding of large-scale building projects  Ability to interpret, review, and coordinate technical construction documentation  Familiarity with ISO19650 BIM standards is a strong advantage  Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills  What We Offer · The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects. · A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence. · Opportunities for professional growth and career progression. Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.  Apply today and be part of something excellent! Kindly upload your CV in English.

title: Bim modeler - mep
description: MEP BIM Modeler - UAE  Are you a hands-on professional with a passion for precision and performance? Join us in delivering high-quality MEP systems for landmark projects in the UAE.  This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEMCO will be holding interviews in the following cities.  Sau Paulo, Brazil  Rio de Janeiro, Brazil  Bogota, Columbia  Who we are! ALEC Engineering and Contracting L. L. C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises  In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.  ALEMCO provides integrated MEP and facilities services that power some of the region’s most ambitious developments. From electrical systems to long-term maintenance, we focus on technical reliability and sustainable performance - supported by an inclusive and skilled team with a passion for engineering excellence.  Why Join Us? As a BIM Modeler, you’ll play a pivotal role in transforming design information into precise 3 D models and construction documents. You’ll support our field operations with shop drawings, schedules, and coordinated data, driving project accuracy and collaboration forward.  At ALEMCO, we’re about more than just building iconic structures - we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious projects, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us to deliver Project Planning and Controls initiatives that directly shape our business success, from sourcing candidates to enhancing candidate experiences.  Your Role  Review tender and IFC information (2 D drawings, BIM models, asset data) per ISO19650 standards  Create and maintain Revit-based BIM models, including GA plans, sections, diagrams, and schedules  Perform clash detection and support clash avoidance coordination  Maintain clean, healthy BIM models following industry best practices  Update and revise models/documents based on RFIs, design changes, and site instructions  Identify inconsistencies in contract documents and flag them appropriately  Assist with as-built documentation and handover preparation  Work collaboratively in shared environments (CDE), supporting both internal and external teams  Follow project standards, templates, protocols, and document control procedures  Provide accurate technical responses to site queries and requests  What We’re Looking For  Technical Diploma in Architecture, Civil or Mechanical Engineering  Minimum 3 years of BIM experience on construction projects  Proficient in Revit and Auto CAD  Familiarity with CDE platforms and coordination tools (Revizto, Navisworks) Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat  Understanding of BIM principles and workflows  Strong written and spoken English skills  What We Offer  Total package of salary, UAE Employment Visa, Medical Insurance & Annual ticket allowance.  The chance to contribute to some of the UAE's most iconic projects.  A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence.  Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.  Ready to Lead? If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.  Join ALEMCO and shape the future of infrastructure delivery in the UAE.  Apply today and be part of something extraordinary.

title: Bim modeler - civil
description: Civil BIM Modeler - Design | UAE  Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects? This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.  Sau Paulo, Brazil  Rio de Janeiro, Brazil  Bogota, Columbia  Who We are? ALEC Holdings L. L. C - S. O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.  In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.  ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.  Why Join Us? As a  Civil BIM Modeler  , you will be responsible for developing and managing BIM models for our construction projects in compliance with ISO19650 and company standards. You will lead the BIM modeling efforts, coordinate with project teams, ensure model accuracy, and support BIM QA/QC processes to deliver quality outputs that meet project requirements.  At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities, we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.  Your Role  Review Tender & IFC BIM models, 2 D drawings, and asset data issued by consultants in line with ISO19650 standards.  Lead BIM modeling for design documents; guide and mentor a team of modelers.  Prepare BIM models and generate general arrangement plans, diagrams, sections, elevations, and schedules using Revit.  Maintain and optimize BIM models following best industry practices to ensure healthy, coordinated models.  Coordinate with BIM and design teams to support modeling from 2 D CAD plans and construction documents.  Conduct clash detection and support clash avoidance measures.  Assist internal and external stakeholders with the development and updating of construction documents.  Maintain and apply company/project BIM standards, templates, and content.  Update models and drawings based on RFI responses, engineering instructions, and design changes.  Identify discrepancies in contract documents and report them promptly.  Ensure all work complies with project information standards, BIM Execution Plans, and ALEC BIM implementation standards.  Support as-built/redline and handover processes by updating models and extracting accurate drawings.  Provide timely and accurate information to site teams and project managers.  Follow a Monday to Saturday work schedule consistent with project-based industry norms.  What We’re Looking For  Diploma in Architecture or Civil Engineering (3 years). title: Foreman - fitout
description: We're Hiring:  Fit-Out Foremen for High-End Interior Projects in UAE/KSA  ALEC FITOUT,  a division of ALEC Holdings and part of the Investment Corporation of Dubai (ICD), is a leading specialist in high-end interior fit-out and refurbishment projects across the hospitality, commercial, cultural, and retail sectors. We bring visionary interiors to life through precision execution and world-class craftsmanship.  ALEC FITOUT  is seeking for a  Fit-Out Foreman  , who will be on the frontlines of construction, managing daily site operations, supervising tradesmen, and ensuring quality and productivity in every task. You’ll oversee the execution of interior finishes and report progress, snags, and safety matters directly to your site leadership team.  Please note that this role will be assigned to ALEC FITOUT project, based in  UAE/KSA.  The position requires a  six-day working week  , which is mandatory for all site-based roles.  Successful candidates must be eligible to obtain a work visa for UAE/KSA.  Your Role:  Review daily schedules and assign work based on priorities and skills.  Lead teams in fit-out trades including marble, woodwork, metal, glazing, partitions, ceilings, and painting.  Interpret and explain technical drawings to ensure accurate and timely task completion.  Ensure that all work is completed safely and in compliance with HSE policies.  Manage tools, materials, and manpower to ensure productivity and efficiency.  Conduct quality checks, resolve minor site issues, and escalate critical ones to the Site Manager.  Record and report daily site progress, delays, and corrective actions.  Train, coach, and mentor team members to develop their technical and safety competencies.  Maintain discipline and promote teamwork on-site.  What You’ll Need:  Minimum 5–7 years’ hands-on experience in the construction industry.  At least 2 years’ experience as a Fit-Out Foreman managing multiple trades on high-end projects.  Previous experience in luxury interior fit-out is a must (hospitality, retail, commercial, or high-end residential).  Strong leadership and communication skills – able to coordinate diverse teams and subcontractors.  Solid understanding of technical drawings, construction materials, and interior finishes.  Proven track record in productivity improvement, quality management, and safety enforcement.  Basic computer skills and the ability to write daily reports in English.  Valid First Aid Certificate is a plus.  Fluent in English  Core Technical Skills:  Interior Fit-Out Execution  Expertise in Fit-Out Trades  Site Supervision & Task Planning  Material Calculation & Usage  Health & Safety Compliance  Productivity & Resource Optimization  Please ensure to attach your CV in English when applying.

A inscrição neste banco de talentos não garante a contratação, pois ela dependerá da avaliação de currículos e requisitos de cada uma das oportunidades.  Quem pode se candidatar? Para as posições de nível gerencial e de coordenação, exigimos:  Formação superior completa nas áreas de Engenharia Mecânica, Eletromecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou demais áreas correlatas;  Especialização e / ou MBA nas respectivas formações ou áreas de atuação serão um diferencial;  Experiência profissional pregressa nos cargos listados;  Disponibilidade e mobilidade imediata para atuação 100% presencial na região de Barra do Dande (Angola).  Para as posições de supervisão, exigimos:  Formação técnica completa nas áreas de Mecânica, Eletromecânica, Elétrica, Automação ou demais áreas correlatas;  Cursos e / ou certificações nas respectivas áreas de atuação são desejáveis;  Experiência profissional pregressa nos cargos listados;  Disponibilidade e mobilidade imediata para atuação 100% presencial na região de Barra do Dande (Angola).  Experiência Odebrecht Angola:  Aqui, valorizamos o convívio entre as gerações, integrando jovens e profissionais maduros, bem como na diversidade cultural. title: Qa/qc engineer
description: QA/QC Engineer | UAE  Are you a results-driven leader with a proven track record in delivering high-value, mission-critical construction projects? This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.  Sau Paulo, Brazil  Rio de Janeiro, Brazil  Bogota, Columbia  Who We are? ALEC Holdings L. L. C - S. O. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises.  In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.  ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.  Why Join Us? In the role of a QA/QC Engineer, you'll support our project execution teams in delivering high-quality construction projects on schedule. You will be responsible for coordinating and performing QA/QC activities, including inspections, tests, and closeout requirements, ensuring all work complies with project specifications, drawings, and contract requirements.  At ALEC, we’re about more than just building world-class facilities—we’re about building exceptional careers. As a trusted partner to some of the region’s most ambitious developments, we value innovation, operational excellence, and our people. Join us and lead delivery efforts that shape the region’s digital future.  Your Role  Review and understand all project contract documents and specifications.  Conduct daily site inspections to identify and report defects and ensure subcontractor compliance with Inspection Test Plans (ITPs).  Prepare and manage inspection schedules aligned with the project timeline.  Perform work and material inspections, ensuring rejected materials are quarantined and removed.  Collaborate with execution teams to implement corrective actions and conduct root cause analysis for non-conformances.  Monitor Fire & Life Safety installations and ensure compliance with authority regulations.  Track project deliverables, inspection approvals, and quality KPIs using analytical tools.  Support snagging, project closeout, and defect liability period (DLP) activities.  Maintain daily site diaries and QA/QC documentation.  What We’re Looking For  Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent.  Minimum 5 years of experience as a QC Engineer in construction environments.  Strong knowledge of construction processes and quality control standards.  Experience with project closeout procedures and defect management.  Familiarity with MEP works is advantageous.  Analytical skills and experience with data management and basic data analytics.  Excellent communication and coordination skills.  Positive attitude, passion, and commitment to quality work.  What We Offer · The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects. · A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence. · Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.  Ready to plan the path to project success? If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.  Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.  Apply today and be part of something excellent! Kindly upload your CV in English.

Required Qualifications:  Bachelor's degree required.  Supervisory & People Management (Team Management) / Facility Management / Vendor Management experience.  Must be fluent in English (speak, read, write) and Portuguese.  Must be able to pass security background investigations, but do not have to be US citizens. Strong organization and time management skills.  Strong analytical and problem solving skills.  Strong communication skills.  Ability to work in a team environment  Is results oriented and customer focused.  Identifies opportunities for improvement and makes constructive suggestions for change.

title: Gerente contábil sênior
description: O que buscamos? Buscamos uma liderança sênior que domine a contabilidade com profundidade e atue com protagonismo no suporte às decisões da empresa, tendo forte interação com áreas pares, garantindo a integridade, conformidade e eficiência das informações financeiras da empresa, sendo agente de transformação na estruturação de processos, sistemas e controles e reestruturações estratégicas, promovendo a padronização e a escalabilidade destes.  Suas principais responsabilidades serão?• Assinar as demonstrações financeiras da companhia como contador responsável (CRC ativo obrigatório). • Liderar o processo de fechamento contábil mensal, trimestral e anual, com precisão, pontualidade e compliance, assegurando conformidade com CPCs, IFRS e exigências da SEC. • Garantir o atendimento às auditorias externas (PCAOB) com alto padrão de qualidade e governança. • Consolidar as demonstrações financeiras da companhia e preparar os reportes ao controlador internacional conforme regras globais. • Elaborar e revisar notas explicativas às demonstrações financeiras, com ênfase na Nota 08 – Instrumentos Financeiros e Política de Hedge, abrangendo a contabilização de derivativos, aplicação de hedge accounting (cash flow e fair value hedge), gestão de exposições cambiais e riscos de mercado. • Atuar como referência técnica em normas contábeis, com domínio em: IFRS 16 – Arrendamentos, CPC 25 – Provisões, Passivos Contingentes e Ativos Contingentes, e CPC 27 – Ativo Imobilizado. • Liderar a estruturação e manutenção de políticas contábeis e controles internos relacionados às rotinas contábeis. • Promover a transformação da área contábil, reestruturando processos, times e entregas com foco em compliance, eficiência e escalabilidade. • Ser protagonista nas interações com áreas pares, promovendo soluções conjuntas e sinergias nos processos de fechamento e reporte. • Liderar, desenvolver e engajar o time contábil, com foco em performance e entregas confiáveis. • Contribuir com a implementação e/ou evolução de sistemas ERP, com uso intensivo de SAP (preferencialmente), incluindo histórico de participação em projetos. • Apoiar a jornada de fortalecimento da governança corporativa e crescimento sustentável da organização, combinando visão estratégica e conhecimento técnico.  Para isso, precisamos que você possua  : • Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, com registro ativo no CRC (obrigatório). • Pós-graduação em Controladoria, Finanças ou áreas correlatas de Business. • Inglês avançado, com fluência verbal e escrita para comunicação com auditorias e stakeholders internacionais. • Desejável: Especialização ou certificação formal em normas internacionais de contabilidade (IFRS). • Experiência em contabilidade de empresas de capital aberto no Brasil e/ou exterior. • Desejável vivência em processos de IPO ou ambiente pré-IPO. • Passagem por Big Four será considerada um diferencial relevante. • Domínio das normas IFRS e CPCs aplicáveis. • Vivência com ERP SAP e experiência em implementação ou melhorias de sistemas. • Perfil de liderança colaborativa, com forte capacidade de comunicação, influência e orientação para soluções. • Mentalidade de transformação e protagonismo, com atuação técnica sólida e visão estratégica de longo prazo.  Local de Trabalho  : Zona Oeste (Rio de Janeiro) Formato de Trabalho  : Presencial

Knowledge: Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Power Point).  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  Engineering degree (Mechanical / Electrical) with ≥ 10 years’ site experience.  Solid understanding of contract specifications, QA/QC, HSE and programme controls. title: Analista de impostos
description: Vaga disponível inclusive para Pessoas com Deficiência ou Reabilitados pelo INSS.  Principais Responsabilidades  Realizar o  cálculo do IRPJ e CSLL corrente e diferido  (Local e USGAAP), com base no Lucro Real.  Apurar  PIS e COFINS  (a pagar e créditos), sob regime não cumulativo.  Preparar e entregar as  obrigações acessórias  (ECF, EFD-Contribuições, DCTF, DCTFWeb, DIRF, REINF, PER/DCOMP, entre outras).  Apurar  tributos incidentes sobre importação de serviços  e demais eventos relacionados.  Calcular e controlar  IOF e IRRF  sobre operações de mútuo.  Executar  pagamentos e compensações tributárias  , garantindo conformidade e prazos.  Gerir e controlar  créditos tributários  (saldo negativo, pagamento indevido e/ou a maior), assegurando seu correto aproveitamento.  Reconciliar  contas contábeis de impostos diretos  e apoiar o processo de fechamento mensal.  Preparar e consolidar  reportes fiscais de impostos diretos  (mensais, trimestrais e anuais) para a matriz nos EUA.  Atender a  fiscalizações, auditorias externas e internas  , provendo informações técnicas precisas.  Apoiar a análise de  processos tributários em litígio  , acompanhando impactos e desdobramentos.  Fornecer  suporte consultivo  às áreas internas, propondo soluções técnicas e mitigando riscos fiscais.  Organizar e manter atualizado o  arquivo técnico e documental da área tributária .  Apoiar demandas pontuais em  impostos indiretos  , quando necessário.  Requisitos  Graduação completa em  Ciências Contábeis ou Direito . 3 a 4 anos de experiência sólida em Tax Compliance  com foco em impostos diretos.  Proficiência avançada em  Excel  , com habilidade para automatizar e otimizar processos.  Inglês técnico (tributário e contábil) para interação com  Corporate nos EUA  (oral e escrito).  Conhecimento aprofundado em  IRPJ, CSLL, PIS e COFINS  , bem como cálculo e contabilização dos eventos fiscais.  Experiência em  USGAAP  e reconciliação de diferenças entre normas locais e internacionais (desejável).  Histórico de atuação em  ambientes com prazos desafiadores e alta demanda .  Perfil organizado, disciplinado e com forte atenção a detalhes, essencial para área de Tax Compliance.

title: Engenheiro de serviços
description: O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.   Neste cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:  Executar os serviços de acordo com o âmbito do contrato de forma oportuna e com qualidade;  Certificar de ter tudo que você precisa para executar o serviço;  Garantir que todos os serviços cumprem os requisitos de segurança e higiene de acordo com a regulamentação da organização e do cliente;  Suporte técnico ao cliente de acordo com o escopo e conhecimento do engenheiro de serviço;  Entregar relatórios de serviço assinados pelo cliente no final de cada serviço;  Reportar as suas atividades e despesas durante a semana de acordo com o tempo atribuído;  Escalar os problemas e desvios do serviço através de uma comunicação eficaz;  Frequentar os cursos no tempo atribuído;  Dar bom uso e manter em bom estado as ferramentas atribuídas.   Quem você é:  Você antecipa as necessidades dos clientes e fornece serviços que vão além de suas expectativas. Toma medidas rápidas e decisivas em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam os fatos. Você sempre mantém o objetivo em vista e faz um esforço extra para cumprir os prazos.   Para este cargo, você precisará:  Formação em Engenharia elétrica, computação ou relacionada;  Experiência com sistemas de medição de vazão, especificamente para distribuição de gás natural;  Experiência com configuração e manutenção de computadores de vazão da linha Emerson (FB107, ROC 800);  Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência com automação industrial;  Inglês avançado;  Disponibilidade para viagens;  Possuir CNH válido (categoria B);  Local: Rio de Janeiro, RJ.   Qualificações preferenciais que o diferenciam:  Conhecimento em sistemas de telemetria;  Conhecimento em sistemas SCADA;  Conhecimento em calibração de transmissores e medidores.  Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:  Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.  Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Senior cost control analyst (cost controller)
description: OPORTUNIDADE –  Senior Cost Control Analyst (Cost Controller)  Estou em busca de um Senior Cost Control Analyst (Cost Controller) para atuar em projeto no setor de Óleo e Gás.  Duração estimada do contrato: 12 meses, com possibilidade de extensão mensal.  Requisitos  Formação superior em Administração, Contabilidade, Economia ou Engenharia de Produção.  Excelentes habilidades em Excel Avançado e experiência em SAP.  Excelentes habilidades interpessoais, com interface frequente com outros departamentos.  Conhecimento do setor de Óleo e Gás.  Inglês fluente.  Experiência de 8 anos ou mais (desejável).  Principais Atividades  Elaborar o orçamento interno do ativo e as previsões de fechamento, em conjunto com a equipe técnica, e realizar o acompanhamento.  Emitir relatórios mensais comparando Capex e Opex realizados versus orçamento e última previsão.  Atuar ativamente no processo P2 P (Purchase to Pay): aprovar requisições de compra, emitir ordens de compra, processar recebimento de bens/serviços e participar das reuniões “Triplet” (Equipe Técnica, Comprador e Controle de Custos) para áreas técnicas e não técnicas.  Participar de reuniões de Joint Venture (como FCM) e fornecer suporte com documentação, apresentações e explicações quando necessário.  Revisar informações e valores para atividades de fechamento, incluindo provisões de custos técnicos e ciclos de alocação de custos de operação.  Executar controles de conformidade SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) relacionados ao controle de custos das áreas sob sua responsabilidade.

title: Site reliability engineer
description: About the company  Personetics is shaping the Cognitive Banking era, harnessing AI to help banks anticipate customer needs, provide actionable insights, and deliver intelligent financial guidance. Our platform continuously analyzes and leverages real-time transactional data, enabling banks to proactively support customers in managing their finances and reaching their goals. As industry leaders—yes, we really are leaders—we partner with the world’s top financial institutions, empowering over 150 million customers monthly across 35 global markets from offices in New York, London, Singapore, São Paulo, and Tel Aviv.  About the position  We are seeking a Site Reliability Engineer to join our Cloud Operations team in Brazil. In this role, you’ll help design, deploy, and maintain reliable, scalable cloud solutions, support customer onboarding, troubleshoot production issues, and optimize system performance. This is a great opportunity to grow your skills while working with modern cloud, container, and automation technologies in a global, fast-paced environment.  Responsibilities  Install, integrate, and operate end-to-end solutions and features, from design to production.  Manage production systems and oversee CI/CD pipelines.  Support customers during onboarding, including connecting and integrating their data into our system.  Research, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve recurring environment issues.  Participate in the on-call rotation and serve as an escalation point for incidents.  Contribute to service design and architecture to proactively prevent system failures.  Requirements 2-5 years of experience in Application Integration, SRE, or Production Operations.  Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field  Hands-on experience with: - Linux and Docker - Kubernetes on AKS or other container orchestration tools - Helm package manager - Azure cloud. - Terraform or similar Ia C tools; experience with Git Ops - CI/CD solutions, preferably Jenkins - Networking, including configuring WAF rules, IP whitelisting, and troubleshooting  Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize effectively.  Excellent communication skills.  High level of proficiency in English, both written and spoken.  Nice to have  Experience with Maven and Nexus or similar registry solutions  Familiarity with Git version control systems  Knowledge of databases such as My SQL and Postgre SQL  Scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Groovy  Customer-facing experience. ** Please submit your CV in English.

title: Site manager
description: Site Manager | UAE  Ready to build what others only imagine? As a  Site Manager  at ALEC, you’ll turn blueprints into landmarks, managing execution with precision, speed, and impact.  This role is based on-site in the UAE and will require relocation. ALEC will be holding interviews in the following cities.  Sau Paulo, Brazil  Rio de Janeiro, Brazil  Bogota, Columbia  Who We are? ALEC Engineering and Contracting L. L. C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises  In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.  ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.  Why Join Us? As a Site Manager in ALEC Building, you will be responsible for overseeing all finishing aspects of construction projects including blockwork, POP work, plastering, painting, and carpentry, ensuring timely delivery within budget and to the highest quality standards.  Your Role  Develop and control site plans for finishing works, accurately calculating required human and material resources.  Create, implement, and enforce comprehensive Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) plans on site.  Lead and motivate construction teams, ensuring clear communication and high performance.  Collaborate with the Commercial Team to monitor and control construction costs, addressing any anomalies.  Establish and maintain a robust quality management system and control plan for finishing works.  Liaise with clients, authorities, consultants, and stakeholders to provide timely project updates.  Interpret and apply technical drawings, tender documents, and contract requirements effectively.  Monitor productivity and progress, ensuring accurate measurement and recording of works.  Manage testing of technical components, interpreting results and implementing corrective actions.  Plan and prepare for upcoming contracts, including tender revision, scheduling, and site setup.  What We’re Looking For  Bachelor’s degree or equivalent (BEng, BTEC, ND) in Civil Construction or related field.  Minimum 10 years’ experience in construction, preferably in finishing works.  Strong leadership, planning, communication, and commercial acumen.  Proven ability to manage complex construction projects on time and within budget.  Sound knowledge of HSE standards and quality control procedures.  What We Offer · The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects. · A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence. · Opportunities for professional growth and career progression.  Ready to plan the path to project success? If you’re inspired by what you’ve read and believe you’re the right fit, we’d love to hear from you.  Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.  Apply today and be part of something excellent! Kindly upload your CV in English.

title: General foreman

ALEC Engineering and Contracting L. L. C. (ALEC), part of ICD, is a leading GCC construction company known for delivering complex, high-profile projects. With 20+ years of experience, ALEC builds across sectors including airports, hospitality, retail, and high-rises  In the UAE, ALEC has delivered many of the nation’s most iconic developments, operating as a fully integrated contractor through specialist business units that provide end-to-end construction solutions.  ALEC Building forms the structural heart of the Group, delivering high-value construction projects from foundation to finish. Whether commercial towers or luxury hospitality developments, we build safely, collaboratively, and with precision, laying the groundwork for long-term success.  Why Join Us? As a  General Foreman  , you’ll lead multiple structural work zones, from formwork and concrete to steel and blockwork. You’ll manage a team of Senior Foremen, ensuring all structural activities are planned, resourced, executed, and handed over to the highest technical and safety standards. Your role is critical to coordinating construction efforts, maintaining productivity, and upholding ALEC’s commitment to quality and environmental compliance.  About Your Team  You’ll report to the  Section Manager  and lead teams of Senior Foremen, Foremen, and labour across various structural disciplines. You’ll work closely with planning, procurement, safety, and QA/QC teams to ensure seamless execution across all phases of work.  Your Role  As a General Foreman, you will:  Lead and support Foremen in managing labour and tradesmen across all structural work fronts.  Interpret structural drawings and ensure accurate site setup and execution.  Plan resources effectively and manage site access, logistics, and emergency readiness.  Ensure the timely procurement and correct usage of construction materials and plant.  Enforce ALEC’s safety policies, ensuring work is carried out using the proper PPE and safety procedures.  Manage heavy equipment and ensure only qualified operators handle machinery.  Coordinate across structural teams including carpentry, steel, rebar, blockwork, and concrete.  Drive productivity initiatives, ensuring teams work at optimal efficiency.  Lead by example, coach site teams, and identify upskilling needs for unskilled labour.  Ensure compliance with ISO standards, carry out quality audits, and implement corrective actions.  Support environmental management before, during, and after construction phases.  Oversee the structural handover process with complete documentation and quality verification.  What We’re Looking For  Experience  : 10+ years in construction with at least 2 years as a Senior Foreman, specifically in structural works.  Certifications  : First Aider qualification is required.  Technical Knowledge  : Strong understanding of structural works including formwork, blockwork, rebar, and carpentry.  Leadership  : Proven ability to manage large, multi-disciplinary site teams and interface with support functions.  Planning & Coordination  : Skilled in short-term planning, resource control, and progress tracking.  Communication  : Effective communicator who builds trust across teams and levels.  Safety & Quality  : Committed to site safety and consistent delivery to quality standards.  What We Offer · The chance to contribute to some of UAE most iconic projects. · A collaborative, supportive environment that values innovation and excellence. · Opportunities for professional growth and career progression. Join ALEC and play a pivotal role in shaping a high-performing team that drives our success.  Apply today and be part of something excellent! Kindly upload your CV in English.

Proficient in project invoicing, subcontracting, and financial reporting.  Strong leadership, negotiation, and team management skills.  Fluent in English  Core Technical Skills:  Interior Fitout  Contract Management & Administration  Cost Control & Budgeting  Procurement & Subcontractor Management  Project Financial Reporting  Project Scheduling & Planning  Please ensure to attach your  CV in English  when applying.
